action_summary: Add deterministic original/horizontal-flip probability averaging using the existing Xception checkpoint. This is an untested but credible variance-reduction experiment; preserve the original resolution, normalization, label order, and Kaggle paths rather than assume different checkpoint preprocessing. Stream each view sequentially with training=False, preserve batch size, bound preprocessing/prefetch memory, load the model with compile=False, and make exploratory plots optional. Validate prediction count/range/finiteness, save aligned per-view predictions for subsequent ablation, and write submission.csv. No training or inference was run locally; leaderboard improvement remains unverified.
